response.sql: SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId WHERE res.positionOrder > 12 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name ORDER BY (AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) IS NULL), avg_laps DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: laps is stored as TEXT, so it is cast to REAL before averaging. Rows with NULL laps are ignored by AVG, and a race whose laps are all NULL gets a NULL average and is placed last.
Ties in the average at the 10th place are broken arbitrarily, because the request gives no tie-breaker.
